title: More Solutions Architecture
summary: Reusable designs that SAA-C03 scenarios test: where failed messages go when Lambda reads from SQS, SQS FIFO or SNS, SNS-to-SQS fan-out, S3 event notifications with and without EventBridge, CloudTrail API-call alerts, API Gateway writing straight into Kinesis, caching layers, blocking an IP behind an ALB, NLB or CloudFront, the HPC service stack, and keeping a single EC2 instance highly available with an Auto Scaling group of one and an Elastic IP.
